title: Snake's Unexpected Enemy, Nagin Refused to Meet, Cobra Devoured It in Anger
summary: A snake and a nagin (a type of serpent) were reportedly seen together, but the nagin refused to meet. The situation escalated into anger, resulting in the cobra devouring the nagin alive. This incident has raised questions about the relationship between snakes and nagins.
summary_points: A snake and a nagin were spotted together, leading to an unexpected confrontation.
The nagin refused to meet with the snake, which led to increased tension.
The situation escalated into anger, resulting in the cobra devouring the nagin alive.
This incident has raised questions about the relationship between snakes and nagins.
The incident highlights the complex interactions between different species in the wild.
